name: Home Assistant
description: Contrôlez et automatisez tous vos appareils domotiques en local.
compose:
services:
  homeassistant:
    image: ghcr.io/home-assistant/home-assistant:stable
    container_name: homeassistant
    restart: unless-stopped
    privileged: true
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - TZ={{TZ}}
    volumes:
      - {{APPDATA}}/config:/config
      - /run/dbus:/run/dbus:ro

en.description: Control and automate all your smart home devices locally.
